purpose: Validate handoffs, resolve ordered integration and own the final completion claim.
route_when: One or more worker artifacts are ready to combine into a parent task.
do_not_route_when: No delegated or independently produced artifact requires integration.
non_goals: Trust worker claims without rerunning integration checks
risk_limits: Reject stale base, out-of-scope writes and missing evidence.
runtime_constraints: Only this role closes the parent task.
